title: PRO endpoints (FDA PRO guidance 2009)
source_note: FDA Patient-Reported Outcome Measures guidance (final, Dec 2009); see also the PFDD guidance series

items.title: Concept of interest
items.requirement: The concept measured and its link to the intended claim are stated.
items.query: concept of interest claim conceptual framework

items.title: Content validity
items.requirement: Evidence that the instrument captures what matters to patients (qualitative input) is cited.

items.title: Recall period
items.requirement: The recall period is specified and appropriate to the concept.

items.title: Measurement properties
items.requirement: Reliability, construct validity and ability to detect change are documented.
items.query: reliability construct validity ability to detect change

items.title: Administration
items.requirement: Mode, timing and order of administration and any translations / cultural adaptation are described.
items.query: mode of administration translation cultural adaptation

items.title: Scoring and missing items
items.requirement: The scoring algorithm and handling of missing items/domains are specified.

items.title: Interpretation
items.requirement: A responder definition or meaningful within-patient change threshold is pre-specified and justified (e.g. anchor-based).
items.query: responder definition clinically meaningful change interpretation anchor

items.title: Multiplicity across domains
items.requirement: Multiplicity across PRO domains/items is addressed.
